findings.title: Generated curatedGuides.ts imports './schema' without .js; fails backend tsc under NodeNext
findings.fix: sync-shared emits `from './schema.js'` for both targets; backend imports generated files with .js extensions.

findings.title: Frontend tsconfig/scripts unspecified; skipLibCheck:false breaks build (hls.js types need TS>=5.7, pinned TS 5.6.3)
findings.fix: Specify frontend tsconfig with skipLibCheck:true, moduleResolution bundler; define build/typecheck/test scripts for both apps; backend include:["src"].

findings.title: GuideDraftSchema contradictory (per-section confidence vs top-level map) and not written out
findings.fix: Define GuideDraftSchema explicitly with a top-level confidence object of nine literal SECTION_KEYS (see review snippet).

findings.title: Offline zodResponseFormat test does not catch strict-mode violations (verified: .optional() and .url() accepted)
findings.fix: Test walks the emitted JSON schema asserting additionalProperties:false, required==all keys, and no format/pattern/length/min/max/default keywords.

findings.title: StreamEvent TS shape and server/client error-code unions undefined
findings.fix: Add discriminated union { event, data } plus ErrorCode/ClientErrorCode/Stage types to shared/schema.ts; route emits meta and done.

findings.title: Abort/timeout error mapping unspecified; OpenAI SDK throws APIUserAbortError not signal.reason
findings.fix: Route catch: if signal.aborted use signal.reason code; llm.ts never retries after abort; map OpenAI connection/5xx errors to LLM_FAILED retryable; per-call timeouts via AbortSignal.any.

findings.title: Concurrency check-then-acquire race across async limiter; inline limiter(req,res,next) hangs on 429
findings.fix: Middleware chain with synchronous concurrency.tryAcquire() before limiter; limiter handler releases slot; release in finally.

findings.title: Whitespace collapse runs before control-char rejection, so \t/\n are accepted (violates FR6)
findings.fix: Reject /\p{Cc}/u on raw input first, then trim and collapse spaces.

findings.title: Post-processing does not coerce LLM output to schema minimums/optionals; app.website not allow-listed
findings.fix: Add normalizeDraft: null->undefined, drop empty items, placeholder for empty required strings, default review.types, fix durations, hostname as empty title, website allow-listed like consoleUrl, supported+0 steps -> unclear.

findings.title: GuideSummary lacks aliases but Library search matches aliases
findings.fix: Add 'aliases' to GuideSummary Pick and toSummary; test 'gmail' finds Google Workspace.

findings.title: UI section -> confidence key mapping unspecified (AC 17)
findings.fix: Add explicit mapping table; Summary and Sources carry no tag; test asserts nine tags.

findings.title: Client handling of pre-stream errors (retryable/titles) and keys-missing banner unspecified
findings.fix: Add per-code title/retryable table in src/lib/errors.ts; Generate page checks /api/health and shows non-blocking 'Live research isn't configured' banner while keeping form enabled.

findings.title: PDF section-id post-check impossible: marked 15 emits no heading ids; ids never listed; 10 vs 11 content files
findings.fix: Wrap each content file in <section id="sec-<stem>">, check the explicit REQUIRED list, fix content filenames to 11 stems.

findings.title: Figma review.required boolean value undefined
findings.fix: required:false, types:['other'], confidence.review 'uncertain', entry in verification.uncertain.

findings.title: source.index and read-{i} numbering ambiguous
findings.fix: 0-based candidate-list position, display-only.

findings.title: slugify undefined
findings.fix: NFKD, lowercase, non-[a-z0-9]+ -> '-', trim, fallback 'app'.

findings.title: Cold-start notice text differs from AC 20
findings.fix: Use exact 'Waking up the agent server…' everywhere; first byte = fetch resolved.

findings.title: chunkSizeWarningLimit 900 below measured ~1.1 MB three chunk
findings.fix: Set 1200 or accept warning; correct estimate.

findings.title: Nested three@0.170 under stats-gl; deprecated three-mesh-bvh
findings.fix: Do not import StatsGl/Bvh; optional overrides.

findings.title: Empty ALLOWED_ORIGINS string yields empty allow-list
findings.fix: Treat '' as unset; warn in production when only localhost origins.

findings.title: TRUST_PROXY=1 on Render unverified
findings.fix: Debug-log req.ip; README step to confirm and adjust.

findings.title: Screenshot script assumes running preview server
findings.fix: Pre-flight fetch(BASE_URL) and exit 1 with start instructions.

findings.title: IsoDate accepts impossible dates
findings.fix: Add round-trip Date refine.

findings.title: GuideDetail shows Retry for 400 INVALID_SLUG
findings.fix: Treat 400 like 404.

findings.title: Store re-validation ownership stated inconsistently
findings.fix: State once: every GuideStore.get safeParses and returns null on failure.
